description: NirmaanAI Data Volume Optimization & Tuning Subsample Registry
canonical_data_policy: Canonical datasets remain 100% full and immutable in models/processed/. Subsets are computational aids only.

industrial_iot_failure.strategy: Deterministic stratified joint class & machine type sampling

textile.strategy: Deterministic synchronized temporal stride (stride=2 across looms)

synthetic_factory.strategy: Deterministic synchronized multi-station temporal stride (stride=2 across M1-M5)

ai4i.reason: Dataset size is already compact (7,000 train rows); volume reduction provides negligible gain while risking rare failure mode representation.

cmapss.reason: Engine-grouped physics trajectories must preserve complete run-to-failure curves across all 70 training engines (14,130 rows).

secom.reason: Wafer defect dataset is already small (1,096 train rows) with only 6.6% defect prevalence.

manufacturing_production.reason: Production dispatch log contains only 700 training rows; reduction would severely degrade ranking quality.

manufacturing_defects.reason: Batch quality dataset contains 2,268 training rows; highly compact and fast to train.
